i.norm: Verifies that JsonFormat.Value correctly stores and exposes shape, leniency, radix, and pattern when constructed with explicit non-null values. Key behaviors checked: - hasShape() returns true when shape is not Shape.ANY - hasLenient() returns true when lenient is non-null (even if Boolean.FALSE) - getRadix() and getPattern() return the values provided at construction
Invalid timezone ID "-d`" resolves to GMT; presence of a non-null TimeZone is what matters here
Explicitly set lenient to FALSE (non-null), so hasLenient() must return true
Shape is NUMBER_FLOAT, not the default ANY, so hasShape() must be true
lenient was set to Boolean.FALSE (not null), so hasLenient() must be true
